assumptions: Per metre length of dam. Vertical upstream face; the cross-section is a rectangle (crest width x dam height) plus a downstream triangle reaching the full base width. Concrete unit weight 24 kN/m3, water 9.81 kN/m3. Reservoir water depth measured from the base. Uplift is triangular: full hydrostatic pressure at the heel multiplied by the uplift factor, zero at the toe. Ignore cohesion, tailwater, silt and seismic loads. FS_overturning = resisting moments / overturning moments, both about the toe; water thrust and uplift are overturning.
